title: VAERION Registry Definitions — The Seven Sub-Registries
authority: VAERION_VISUAL_SYSTEM_v1.0.1 §0 (all visual decisions resolve through exactly seven registries; a value that does not resolve through a registry does not exist)
VAERION_IMPLEMENTATION_CONSTITUTION_v1.0 2.1 (one canonical Registry; no mirror, copy, or derivative)

registries.name: Space
registries.governs: all spacing, page architecture, ceremonial distance
registries.scaleAuthority: Gauge Ladder — VS §1.2 (ratified ramp: 0 / 2 / 4 / 8 / 12 / 16 / 24 / 32 / 48 / 64 / 96 / 128 px; index record ambiguity filed as IR-004)

registries.name: Type
registries.governs: the two voices, sizes, weights, tracking, line heights
registries.scaleAuthority: Type Scale — VS §2.2 (the scale exists in law; its numeric sizes are not enumerated in the ratified text — numeric pins are pending governance, IR-005; no size token may be compiled until ruled)

registries.name: Shape
registries.governs: radii, hairlines, geometry vocabulary, chain geometry, seal geometry
registries.scaleAuthority: Radius Ladder — VS §3.2 (0 / 2 px / 4 px / 8 px / seal (∞)); hairline width VS §3.3; Chainline VS §3.5; registered seal sizes VS §5.2
registries.offScaleRule: A radius used outside its registered role is a violation (VS §3.2).

registries.name: Color
registries.governs: grounds, ink, verdict chromatics, accent, budget
registries.scaleAuthority: VS §4.7 reference value tables — the sole ratified color-value source
registries.offScaleRule: No surface, code path, or document may introduce a color value outside the §4.7 tables (VS §4.7; Bible Art. XI; Constitution 1.3).

registries.name: Motion
registries.governs: durations, curves, the three canonical motions
registries.scaleAuthority: Motion Registry — VS §7.1 (exactly three canonical motions); Motion Law VS §7.2 (max 400 ms; settle-out curve cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1))
registries.offScaleRule: No fourth motion may be invented (VS §7.1); registered curves only (VS §7.2).

registries.name: Elevation
registries.governs: the layer system and its ordinals
registries.scaleAuthority: Layer system — VS §3.4 (ground.0 → surface.1 → sticky.2 → veil.3 → floating.4 → ceremony.5 → lens.6)
registries.offScaleRule: Shadows are prohibited; glass is prohibited (VS §3.4).

registries.name: Icon
registries.scaleAuthority: Icon law — VS §8 (registered grid; stroke hairline-consistent per §3.3; sizes matching the registered seal sizes where paired with verdicts)
registries.offScaleRule: Icons never carry verdict color, never replace seals, never decorate (VS §8).

governanceReferences.requestPath: interpretation requests resolve how existing law applies (Constitution 11.2)
governanceReferences.valueSource: authority §8 (the ratified Visual System text, digest-pinned by the Snapshot Authority)
